subject: general
question: Which organisation in India holds the responsibility for setting the maximum residue limits (MRLs) of pesticides in food materials?

options.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)** is responsible for setting the maximum residue limits (MRLs) of pesticides in food materials.
 
• The FSSAI was established under the **Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006**, which consolidates various acts and orders related to food safety and regulation in India.
 
• It is an autonomous body under the **Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India**.
 
• The primary aim of FSSAI is to ensure that the food products being sold are safe for consumption and meet the required standards.
 
• FSSAI sets standards for food articles and regulates their manufacture, storage, distribution, sale, and import to ensure the availability of safe and wholesome food for human consumption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006** was enacted to provide a systematic and comprehensive approach to food safety and regulation.
 
• FSSAI operates at the central level, while there are corresponding State Food Safety Authorities in each state for enforcement and implementation at the state level.
 
• The organization also works on promoting general awareness about food safety and hygiene among consumers and food businesses.
 
• FSSAI's regulations and standards are regularly updated to address emerging challenges and advancements in food science and technology.
